skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated: no card in Forge gives a creature a second instance of increment, so a creature never has two instances in a two-player game; each single instance's behavior is covered by 702.191a-1 and 702.191a-2

scenarios.title: Increment puts a +1/+1 counter when the mana spent exceeds the creature's power or toughness
decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping two Forests (2 mana spent).
The increment trigger goes on the stack above Grizzly Bears; both players pass; the trigger resolves, then Grizzly Bears resolves.

variants.label: two_mana_spent
variants.expected: Increment triggers: 2 mana spent is greater than Cuboid Colony's power 1 and toughness 1. Cuboid Colony gets a +1/+1 counter and is a 2/2.

variants.label: colony_already_2_2
variants.delta: Cuboid Colony already has a +1/+1 counter (it is a 2/2).
variants.expected: Increment does not trigger: 2 mana spent is not greater than power 2 or toughness 2. Cuboid Colony stays a 2/2 with one counter.

variants.label: one_mana_spent
variants.delta: A casts Llanowar Elves (1 mana spent) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Increment does not trigger: 1 mana spent is not greater than power 1 or toughness 1. Cuboid Colony stays a 1/1.

scenarios.title: Increment compares the mana spent with power and toughness separately
decisions: A casts Hill Giant, tapping four Mountains (4 mana spent).
The increment trigger goes on the stack above Hill Giant; both players pass; the trigger resolves, then Hill Giant resolves.

variants.label: four_mana_spent
variants.expected: Increment triggers: 4 mana spent is greater than Hungry Graffalon's power 3 (though not greater than its toughness 4). Hungry Graffalon gets a +1/+1 counter and is a 4/5.

variants.label: three_mana_spent
variants.delta: A casts Gray Ogre, tapping three Mountains (3 mana spent), instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Increment does not trigger: 3 mana spent is greater than neither power 3 nor toughness 4. Hungry Graffalon stays a 3/4.
